mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in a month signals aggressive Fed easing, lowering real rates and boosting equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day prior period (t-test p > 0.05) during the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE predicts stronger labor market absorption, reducing expected wage growth and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative relative to a baseline of stable labor indicators (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST above 1,200 signals accelerating industrial demand, which elevates corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive in 70% of months with HOUST > 1,200 (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO below 105 indicates softening supply-side conditions, raising uncertainty and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of INDPRO < 105 months (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in a month, the inflation surprise prompts a preemptive rate hike anticipation, depressing near-term equity valuations and producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in 3 out of 4 months with CPIAUCSL > +0.5% change (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in PAYEMS and UNRATE over two consecutive months signal weakening labor absorption, lowering wage growth expectations and pushing S&P 500 60-day forward returns to the negative.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases for two consecutive months while UNRATE also decreases
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative in 60% of such labor cooling episodes (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rising trend in GDPC1 above 16,500 billion USD indicates robust consumer demand, elevating earnings expectations and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in 80% of GDPC1 > 16,500 months (F-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls by more than 10% in a month, it reflects sudden supply-side disruptions, raising uncertainty and compressing S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in 50% of RSAFS < -10% events (binomial test).
